entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
4.0.359.0

4.0.359.0 (2026-10-27 18:12 UTC)

  • BedrockAgentCoreControl (4.0.124.0)
    • Adds the ResetTokenVaultKeyMaterial API, which restores a token vault whose customer managed key was deleted by moving it to an AWS owned key. The reset permanently deletes the stored OAuth 2.0 tokens, users must consent again. Adds on-behalf-of token exchange client authentication override option.
  • DynamoDBv2 (4.0.109.3)
    • DynamoDBv2 is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
    • Added the InvalidEndpointException type. Operations that return HTTP 421 now throw InvalidEndpointException, a subclass of AmazonDynamoDBException, instead of the base exception.
  • EC2 (4.0.130.0)
    • EC2 AMIs can now show vulnerability data and be targeted directly for scanning.
  • ECS (4.0.109.0)
    • ECS now supports GPU sharing via NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS) on ECS Managed Instances and ECS EC2, allowing multiple ECS tasks to share a single Nvidia GPU for improved utilization.
  • Inspector2 (4.0.107.0)
    • Adding support for Machine Image scan
  • LicenseManager (4.0.102.0)
    • AWS License Manager now supports delegate grants for read-only visibility into license distributions. CreateGrant accepts a new GrantType (BuyerGrant or DelegateGrant) and a desired status at distribution time.
  • Lightsail (4.0.105.0)
    • Added the attributeUpdates parameter to the Lightsail StartInstance API, which allows customers to update the attributes of a stopped instance when starting it.

entry.content:
Azure.Provisioning_1.7.0-beta.1

1.7.0-beta.1 (2026-10-27)

Features Added

  • Added JSON serialization and deserialization for Infrastructure and Bicep syntax nodes through ModelReaderWriter, including schema-compatible decorators, 64-bit integers, type annotations, and reverse indexing.
  • Added OfResourceType<T> to upgrade deserialized resources to generated resource types while preserving properties, metadata, conditions, and resource dependencies.
  • Added validation that rejects Bicep constructs without a JSON schema representation, including nested resource access, null suppression, and standalone decorators.

This is the first stable release of this library.

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version from 2026-10-01-preview to the stable 2026-11-01 version.

entry.title: icsharpcode/ILSpy - Releases - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
ILSpy 11.2

In this point release, we kept focussing on improving decompilation accuracy and performance (raw performance as well as memory usage) across the board. This is why again a lot of work went in the category Testing / Infrastructure.

One major performance win to point out is that we now ship ilspycmd with native AOT packages for linux-x64 and win-x64. Measured on win-x64 against the same 3 MB input (ICSharpCode.Decompiler.dll), medians of five runs:

Call shape managed tool AOT package
--version 219 ms 45 ms
-l c (list classes) 384 ms 93 ms
--type one large class 1,446 ms 199 ms
--type one small class 1,797 ms 315 ms
-p whole project (881 files) 6.3 s 2.9 s

For an agent loop that spawns ilspycmd per question that is a 4x to 7x reduction per call!

New Features

  • PR #4248: Add a search box to the Options tab
  • PR #4241: Add opt-in RID-specific and Native AOT packages for ilspycmd
  • PR #4197: Add cross-platform PDB dumping to ilspycmd

Enhancements

  • PR #4268: Native AOT fidelity follow-up: resolver lookup, culture independence, gate coverage
  • PR #4259: Native AOT fidelity for the ICSharpCode.Decompiler package
  • PR #4256: Make ilspycmd -il honor the --type and --member selection
  • PR #4247: Report ilspycmd usage mistakes instead of crashing
  • PR #4236: Transform value.<Clone>$() into value with {} even if there are no initializers
  • PR #4222: Improved decompilation support for VB.NET closures
  • PR #4201: Rewrite VB WithEvents WinForms initialization
  • PR #4160: Decide extension method syntax in CallBuilder
  • PR #4188: Detect generated closure cache types
  • PR #4185: Handle required members on record copy constructors
  • PR #4179: Include member context in decompilation error comments
  • PR #4171: Recognize metadata property backing fields

Testing / Infrastructure

  • PR #4285: Fix decompdiff platform reference staging
  • PR #4283: Improve Debug Steps and decompdiff workflows
  • PR #4276: nugetfuzz: add parallelization + report caught exceptions
  • PR #4274: Migrate ILSpy.sln to the SLNX solution format
  • PR #4269: Cut the ILSpy.Tests wall clock: cheap fixtures, dead waits, duplicate tests, and process sharding
  • PR #4261: Keep tests off the network unless a toolset download is actually needed
  • PR #4255: Add top 500 NuGet package list
  • PR #4254: Reenable LiftedOperators tests
  • PR #4230: Add allocation trace viewer
  • PR #4240: Use local .NET Framework assemblies in nugetfuzz
  • PR #4235: Fallback from unsupported netcoreapp assets in nugetfuzz
  • PR #4205: Clean up package restore (Diasymreader)
  • PR #4187: Let decompdiff reports use full width
  • PR #4184: Separate obfuscated names in nugetfuzz
  • PR #4183: Stream nugetfuzz HTML report generation
  • PR #4177: Index NuGet assemblies by contained name in decompdiff

Contributions

  • PR #4253: Fix #3702: Don't rewrite GetValueOrDefault() to == true in ?. chains — @dualfroz, thank you!
  • PR #4251: Fix #4017: Look through LdObjIfRef on the operand of await — @dualfroz, thank you!
  • PR #4231: Fix #4135: Keep bool-to-int conditional in its local — @dualfroz, thank you!
  • PR #4216: Add option to highlight usages of the symbol at the caret — @pieroviano, thank you!
  • PR #4228: Fix #4153: keep foreach when a named argument inlines the loop variable — @LiquidSnake0, thank you!
  • PR #4232: Fix #4137: Keep nint in conditionals with mixed native int branches — @dualfroz, thank you!

Performance

  • PR #4266: Start the startup warm-ups before Avalonia's setup
  • PR #3963: Substring optimizations: eliminate hot-path allocations (audit top 8)
  • PR #4229: Avoid cloning settings for every method
  • PR #4164: Coalesce the global command re-query
  • PR #4157: Coalesce the assembly tree's selection and removal fan-out

Bug Fixes

  • PR #4286: Apply type transformations to fake member signatures
  • PR #4288: Fix exceptions on obfuscated code
  • PR #4250: Fix #4245: Ignore find-panel clicks when resolving reference clicks
  • PR #4249: Fix #4246: Scope prefixes no longer leak into search keywords
  • PR #4225: Fix #2829: Emit continue for leave through try-finally
  • PR #4223: Fix ResXResourceWriter empty output and type names
  • PR #4220: Fix #3180: avoid invalid null-conditional extension calls
  • PR #4206: Fix startup binding errors and background load sweep failure
  • PR #4204: Keep package entry selections decompilable
  • PR #4202: Fix mixed array initializers
  • PR #4200: Reserve captured local names in declaring scope
  • PR #4194: Fix UTF-8 literal span initializers
  • PR #4181: Ignore missing runtime files in XML doc ref-pack lookup
  • PR #4163: Ignore detached tree rows when showing selection
  • PR #4178: Handle expression-tree null conversions
  • PR #4182: Fix #4180: Parenthesize negated negative constants
  • PR #4165: Do not apply cancelled decompilation output

For a full list of changes click here.

This release is based on .NET 10.0. Please make sure that you have it installed on your machine beforehand.

Note for Mac users: see https://github.com/icsharpcode/ILSpy/wiki/Build-Artifacts#running-the-macos-artifact because the ILSpy.app is neither signed nor notarized.

entry.title: microsoft/WindowsAppSDK - Releases - 2026-10-27
entry.content:
Windows App SDK 2.6.4

Windows App SDK 2.6.4 removes the Limited Access Feature requirement for the Language Model APIs, updates ONNX Runtime to 1.27.1, and includes reliability fixes across WinUI 3, app lifecycle, notifications, DispatcherQueue, Content, composition, and Windows AI.

What's new in WinAppSDK 2.6.4:

  • Language Model APIs no longer require a Limited Access Feature unlock. Apps can call the Language Model APIs without first unlocking the Language Model Limited Access Feature. Apps using earlier Windows App SDK versions must continue to follow the LAF requirements for their target Windows versions.
  • Updated ONNX Runtime. The version of ONNX Runtime has been updated to 1.27.1. See ONNX Runtime versions for more info.

Bug fixes:

Bug Fix Runtime Compatibility Change
Fixed an access violation crash that could occur during app shutdown when a text control, such as a TextBox or RichEditBox, was still alive while the XAML core was being torn down. CCoreServices_InputServicesTeardownOrder
Fixed an issue where AppInstance.GetInstances could fail with E_INVALIDARG while enumerating application instances. AppLifecycle_GetInstancesProcessHandleFix
Fixed a crash when calling some AppNotificationManager and AppInstance APIs. AppNotification_AppInstance_FixStackOverflowCrash
Fixed an issue where self-contained apps could fail to load Microsoft.WindowsAppRuntime.Insights.Resource.dll when using the VersionInfo APIs or registering an AppNotification callback (microsoft/WindowsAppSDK#6071, microsoft/WindowsAppSDK#6387). VersionInfo_MissingInsightsResourceDll
Fixed an issue where an unhandled exception in a DispatcherQueue callback could produce a crash dump with only the HRESULT, omitting the app's original exception type, message, and stack trace. DispatcherQueue_CaptureCallbackErrorContext
Fixed the same crash dump issue for unhandled exceptions in DispatcherQueueTimer.Tick event handlers. DispatcherQueueTimer_CaptureTickErrorContext
Fixed an issue where a failure while creating a ContentIsland or other Content object immediately terminated the app. The original error is now returned to the calling code instead. ContentIsland_InitializationFailureCleanup
Fixed system backdrop support for lifted content islands and XAML windows when using the System Composition Engine. SwitcherSystemBackdropBrushSupport
Fixed projection of compatible Windows.UI.Composition objects into Microsoft.UI.Composition, preserving object identity, when using the System Composition Engine. SwitcherColdWrappingWUCToMUC
Fixed a crash in ItemsView when the target of StartBringItemIntoView was collapsed or recycled before the scroll completed (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#11865). ItemsView_InvalidBringIntoViewAnchor
Fixed a crash that could occur when a WebView2 control received focus while still initializing and its parent window was temporarily disabled when initialization finished. WebView2_HandleMoveFocusInvalidArgument
Improved diagnosability for Windows AI model initialization APIs. AIFabric_Tip_APIClassName_ReasonName
Fixed false IntelliSense errors on XAML-generated members, such as InitializeComponent and x:Name fields, in WinUI 3 C# projects edited in VS Code with C# Dev Kit. To opt out, set the EnableWinUIDesignTimeGeneratedXamlCompileItems property to false. N/A, build .targets change

To see everything that's new and changed, see the full Windows App SDK 2.6.4 release notes.

Try it out

  • Download the 2.6.4 NuGet package to use WinAppSDK 2.6 in your app.
  • Download and update the WinUI Gallery to see the WinUI 3 updates firsthand.

Getting started

To get started using Windows App SDK to develop Windows apps, check out the following documentation:

  • Install developer tools.
  • Create a WinUI 3 app.
  • Continue your development journey.
